instruction: The precondition FreeCAD file is saved at /home/user/Precondition_Unnamed.FCStd. Open the mechanical part in FreeCAD and run a horizontal FEM analysis along the Y axis from end to end. Use material AlMg3F24, fix one end, apply a 200 N force on the other end as shown in the image, create a 3D Gmsh FEM mesh with maximum size 2 mm and minimum size 0.5 mm, run the CalculiX solver, generate CCX_Results, Pipeline_CCX_Results, and ccx_dat_file, save the min/max condition CCX result to /home/user/result.csv, and save the completed FreeCAD document to /home/user/Unnamed.FCStd.
